name: webview-copy-toast
title: Webview copy toast component
description: In-webview transient toast shown at the point of interaction for copy actions (grilled: single channel replacing the host status-bar notice; placement near click with top-center fallback; text 'Copied ✓' by default, component supports custom text). Lifecycle: 150ms fade-in, ~1s hold, 250ms fade-out, auto-replace on rapid clicks, prefers-reduced-motion instant, aria-live polite. Wire all copy sites (inspector chips/byte-line/multi-values, integrity value copy).
creator: deviousprophet
